newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to auction T-bills on November 12.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to auction T-bills on November 12.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Ministry said Thursday it will auction 250 million pesos in 91-day treasury bills (Letes) and $250 million in 182-day bills.
The ministry said the auction will be on November 12. Settlement will be on November 15.
Offers are due by 1400 local/1700 GMT. The sale takes place through Dutch style auction.

A further $50 million of 182-day bills and another 50 million pesos of 91-day bills will be allocated. Of those amounts, market-makers may bid for up to $25 million of each issue and the remainder will be kept in the government's portfolio of its own debt.
At the last auction on October 15, 250 million pesos in 91-day bills were sold at a cut-off yield of 7.21 percent and $500 million in 364-day bills were sold at 6.75 percent.
